## ✅ Production Readiness Checklist
Before requesting review, please confirm the following:

- [ ] **Type Safety**: `npm run typecheck` (`npx tsc --noEmit`) passes with **0 errors and 0 warnings**.
- [ ] **Local Testing**: App tested on Expo Go / simulator / physical device.
- [ ] **Bilingual Localization**: UI strings verified in both Bengali (বাংলা) and English.
- [ ] **Offline Resiliency**: App behaves gracefully when offline / on poor network connection.
- [ ] **No Secret Leaks**: No API keys, JWT tokens, or sensitive credentials committed.
- [ ] **Documentation**: Updated `DOCUMENTATION.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` if public APIs or user flows changed.
